newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Western Union said setting up Brussels call centre.
newsitem.headline: Western Union said setting up Brussels call centre.

text.p: U.S. money transfer and messaging group Western Union will soon open a so-called call centre for telephone services for Europe, the Middle East and North Africa, Belgian media said on Monday.
They said the news would be announced officially at a news conference in Brussels on Wednesday.

Brussels region minister Jos Charbert was quoted as saying Brussels had been chosen because of its role as Europe's (informal) capital, the availability of capable and multi-lingual staff and an attractive fiscal climate for such foreign-owned operations.
The centre would employ some 200 people.
Western Union is part of the family of payment instrument businesses owned by First Data Corp.
